This integration connects Gladys to your **Gaz de Bordeaux customer account**
([life.gazdebordeaux.fr](https://life.gazdebordeaux.fr)). It reads your **gas**
and **electricity** consumption there, and its cost, to show them in Gladys,
chart them and start scenes.

It works over the Internet (**cloud** badge): nothing to install at home, no
module on the meter.

## Before you start

- You need an account on [life.gazdebordeaux.fr](https://life.gazdebordeaux.fr)
  that shows your consumption. Sign in once from a browser to check.
- Gaz de Bordeaux publishes the consumption of a day **one or two days later**
  (the time it takes the Gazpar or Linky meter to report it). Gladys therefore
  always shows the **latest day read**, not today.
- Gladys 5.3 or later is required.

## Configuration

1. Open the **Configuration** tab of the integration.
2. Fill in the **email** and **password** of your customer account.
3. Adjust if needed:
   - **Refresh interval (hours)**: how often the customer account is read,
     every 6 hours by default (1 to 24). Readings only change once a day: there
     is no point going lower.
   - **Days of history to import**: past days sent to Gladys when a device is
     created, 30 by default (up to 90), so the charts do not start empty.
   - **Gas / electricity alert threshold (kWh/day)**: above it, the "High daily
     consumption" trigger fires. 0 turns it off.
4. Save. The **Test the connection** button checks the email and password and
   lists the contracts found.
5. Open the **Discovery** tab: one device is offered **per contract**
   ("Gaz de Bordeaux – Gaz", "Gaz de Bordeaux – Électricité"). Add the ones
   you want to follow.

The password is a secret field: it is never written to the logs.

## What you get

Each "contract" device carries read-only sensors:

| Feature                     | Unit | Contract    | Value                               |
| --------------------------- | ---- | ----------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Consumption of the day read | kWh  | all         | one value per day, dated by its day |
| Cost of the day read        | €    | all         | one value per day, dated by its day |
| Gas volume of the day read  | m³   | gas         | one value per day, dated by its day |
| Month consumption           | kWh  | all         | since the 1st of the month          |
| Month cost                  | €    | all         | since the 1st of the month          |
| Year consumption            | kWh  | all         | year total given by Gaz de Bordeaux |
| Year cost                   | €    | all         | year total given by Gaz de Bordeaux |
| Daily consumption           | kWh  | electricity | sent to the Gladys Energy module    |

Daily values are **dated by the day they describe**, not by the time of the
read: the chart shows Monday's consumption on Monday, even when it arrived on
Wednesday.

When a device is created, the last days (see **Days of history to import**)
are imported. They are never sent twice, even after a restart.

### The connection badge

- **Cloud**: the last read succeeded.
- **Cloud with an orange dot**: the customer account answers, but the latest
  reading is more than 4 days old. The meter may have stopped reporting:
  check it on the Gaz de Bordeaux website.
- **Unreachable**: the last read failed (see "Troubleshooting").

## Actions

- **Test the connection**: signs in with the email and password entered and
  lists the contracts found.
- **Refresh now**: reads the customer account right away and gives the latest
  day read.
- **My contract prices**: shows the current prices of your contracts, as
  espaceclient.gazdebordeaux.fr gives them (see "Energy contracts").

## Scenes

The integration adds its cards to the scene editor, under **Integrations**.

### Triggers

- **New daily reading**: Gaz de Bordeaux published a new day. Optionally
  filter on a contract or an energy. The following actions can read
  `{{triggerEvent.data.date}}`, `{{triggerEvent.data.kwh}}`,
  `{{triggerEvent.data.cost}}` and `{{triggerEvent.data.volume}}` (gas).
- **High daily consumption**: the new day goes above the alert threshold set
  in the configuration. Variables: `date`, `kwh`, `threshold`.
- **Customer account unreachable**: reading failed after it had worked. Filter
  on the reason (sign-in refused, request blocked, network, unexpected answer,
  no contract). Variables: `reason`, `message`.
- **Contract prices changed**: a current price of espaceclient.gazdebordeaux.fr
  changed (kWh, peak/off-peak or subscription, incl. VAT). Filter on the
  energy if you like. Variables: `offer`, `kwh_price`, `peak_price`,
  `off_peak_price`, `subscription`, and the previous value of each
  (`previous_kwh_price`…). The prices are read at every refresh and compared
  as the website gives them: no false alarm from rounding. The alert comes
  when the website shows the new price.

A day, or a price change, is announced once, even after a restart. On the very
first read nothing is announced: only the following changes are.

Example: **Contract prices changed** then **Send a message** "New Gaz de
Bordeaux price: \{\{triggerEvent.data.kwh_price\}\} €/kWh (was
\{\{triggerEvent.data.previous_kwh_price\}\}), subscription
\{\{triggerEvent.data.subscription\}\} €/month". Then create a new Gladys energy
contract (see "When your prices change").

### Actions

- **Refresh the Gaz de Bordeaux readings**: reads the customer account right
  away. Outputs: `success` and `contracts` (number of contracts read).
- **Get a Gaz de Bordeaux consumption**: pick a contract and a period (last day
  read, this month, this year). Outputs: `kwh`, `cost`, `volume`, `date` and
  `available` (false when there is no data). Handy for a "Yesterday: 42 kWh,
  €5.10" message.

Example: every morning at 8:00, **Get a consumption** (last day read), then
**Send a message** "Gas on \{\{date\}\}: \{\{kwh\}\} kWh, €\{\{cost\}\}".

## Dashboard

Add the **Gaz de Bordeaux consumption** widget to a dashboard. It shows:

- the consumption and cost of the latest day read and of the month;
- a bar chart of the last 30 days;
- the energy, the latest day read, the gas volume, the current price (read on
  espaceclient), the year total, the time of the last read and the connection
  state;
- a **Refresh** button.

When the latest reading is more than 4 days old, the "Latest day read" row
turns orange: **No new reading since …**.

In the widget settings, pick the contract to show; left empty, it is the
first one.

## Energy contracts (electricity)

The integration adds contract templates to the Gladys contract wizard
(**Energy** → the meter contract), so Gladys computes the cost of your
electricity at the Gaz de Bordeaux prices. One template per offer and option:

| Offer               | Prices                                                             | Templates           |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------- |
| NovaFixe Élec       | locked for 3 years at subscription, 10% below the regulated tariff | Base, Peak/Off-peak |
| NovaFixe Bonus Élec | like NovaFixe, plus €100 off the first year                        | Base, Peak/Off-peak |
| NovaFlex Élec       | indexed on the regulated tariff (TRV), kWh excl. taxes 5% below it | Base, Peak/Off-peak |

**Your offer is not in the list?** (for example **Ecodigo Elec**, or an older
offer no longer sold): pick the **My contract** template below, it works for
every offer. Your offer is written in your customer account, line "Votre
tarif".

### The simplest: the "My contract" templates

The **Gaz de Bordeaux – My contract – Base** and **– Peak/Off-peak**
templates take **your own prices**, for every offer (Ecodigo, NovaFixe,
NovaFlex…). They are the ones of your customer account
(**espaceclient.gazdebordeaux.fr**, line "Votre prix actuel"), given by the
**My contract prices** button:

1. Click **My contract prices** (**Configuration** tab of the integration).
2. In Gladys, **Energy** → the contract of the Gaz de Bordeaux electricity
   meter, pick the **My contract** template of your option (Base or
   Peak/Off-peak).
3. Type the prices the button gave: kWh price (Peak/Off-peak: peak and
   off-peak prices, and the off-peak hours) and subscription per month.

The prices are in the contract, as with the other templates: the wizard and
the JSON of the contract show them. Gladys gives an integration no way to fill
the wizard in, so they are typed once. When they change, the **Contract
prices changed** scene trigger tells you: create a new contract (see "When
your prices change").

### Your prices: the "My contract prices" button

A fixed-price offer keeps **the price of its subscription date**, an indexed
offer (Ecodigo Elec) moves with taxes and market: your price is not
necessarily the one of today's grid. The **My contract prices** button
(**Configuration** tab) reads your current prices on
**espaceclient.gazdebordeaux.fr** (same email and password), line "Votre prix
actuel" of the page of your contract, and gives them as they are, without any
computation. Example:

> Electricity, OFFRE ECODIGO ELEC 100% ÉLECTRICITÉ VERTE (BASE, 6 kVA):
> 0.160164 €/kWh, subscription 15.87 €/month.

These prices include VAT and taxes (CTA in the subscription, excise in the
kWh), like the contracts Gladys offers. Copy them into the Gladys contract wizard
(**My contract** template, or the one of your offer). Type them with a
decimal **point** (15.87), as the button writes them: a pasted comma can be
dropped by the field (15,87 becomes 1587, a subscription of about 51 € a day on
the energy chart). If that happened, correct the price in the contract: that
is a typo, not a price change.

For an electricity contract, the button also gives these prices as a Gladys
tariff (JSON), ready to paste where Gladys asks for the tariff of a contract.
It is the tariff a **My contract** contract
gets. Peak/Off-peak adds an off-peak rule with your
hours (when espaceclient gives them).

```json
{
  "tariff_version": 1,
  "components": [
    { "key": "energy", "kind": "consumption", "rules": [], "fallback": { "price": 0.160164 } },
    { "key": "subscription", "kind": "fixed", "amount": 15.87, "per": "month" }
  ]
}
```

When the customer account cannot be read, the button says so: copy the prices
from the page of your contract on espaceclient.gazdebordeaux.fr.

### When your prices change

Leave the **end date** of your Gladys contract
empty while your prices do not change. They may change along the way: a new grid (NovaFlex, Ecodigo Elec, end
of a fixed-price period), or a tax (excise, VAT) that changes the price incl.
VAT. Gaz de Bordeaux tells you, and so does the **Contract prices changed** scene trigger; the **My contract prices** button then gives the new prices.

1. On the current contract, set the **end date** to the day before the change.
2. Create a **new contract** starting on the day of the change, with the new
   prices.

The past days keep their old prices that way. Do not edit the prices of the
existing contract: Gladys would reprice the whole history since the start of
the contract.

### The default prices: the official grids

The values offered by default are those of the **official Gaz de Bordeaux
price grids** (incl. VAT, here the 1 October 2026 ones). They are downloaded
every month from gazdebordeaux.fr: when a price changes, a new version of the
integration offers the new prices to the contracts created afterwards. A
contract already created keeps its prices: see **When your prices change**.

| Power  | Subscription / month | NovaFixe: Base kWh | NovaFixe: peak / off-peak | NovaFlex: Base kWh | NovaFlex: peak / off-peak |
| ------ | -------------------- | ------------------ | ------------------------- | ------------------ | ------------------------- |
| 3 kVA  | 12.13                | 0.18373            | –                         | 0.19190            | –                         |
| 6 kVA  | 15.87                | 0.18373            | 0.19648 / 0.14669         | 0.19190            | 0.20536 / 0.15280         |
| 9 kVA  | 19.88                | 0.18233            | 0.19648 / 0.14669         | 0.19042            | 0.20536 / 0.15280         |
| 12 kVA | 23.76                | 0.18233            | 0.19648 / 0.14669         | 0.19042            | 0.20536 / 0.15280         |
| 15 kVA | 27.40                | 0.18233            | 0.19648 / 0.14669         | 0.19042            | 0.20536 / 0.15280         |
| 18 kVA | 31.14                | –                  | 0.19648 / 0.14669         | –                  | 0.20536 / 0.15280         |
| 24 kVA | 39.13                | –                  | 0.19648 / 0.14669         | –                  | 0.20536 / 0.15280         |
| 30 kVA | 46.46                | –                  | 0.19648 / 0.14669         | –                  | 0.20536 / 0.15280         |
| 36 kVA | 53.88                | –                  | 0.19648 / 0.14669         | –                  | 0.20536 / 0.15280         |

The subscription is the same for the three offers. NovaFixe Bonus Élec has the
NovaFixe Élec prices.

### Good to know

- **Base** works with the daily consumption this integration sends to the
  Energy module.
- **Peak/Off-peak** needs a **half-hourly** consumption (a Linky meter read
  every 30 minutes by another integration). With the daily consumption only,
  Gladys cannot tell which kWh were off-peak: do not use this template then
- **Gas is not covered**: Gladys energy contracts are for electricity only. The
  gas cost stays the one given by Gaz de Bordeaux ("Cost of the day read",
  "Month cost"… features).

## Troubleshooting

The status message of the **Configuration** tab says what is wrong:

- **Sign-in refused**: the email or password is wrong. Use the ones of
  [life.gazdebordeaux.fr](https://life.gazdebordeaux.fr) and check you can
  sign in from a browser.
- **The website blocked the request**: the Gaz de Bordeaux website sometimes
  filters automated requests. The integration retries at the next refresh; if
  it lasts, open an issue on the GitHub repository.
- **Unreachable**: Gladys has no Internet access, or the website is down.
- **No contract**: the account has no visible gas or electricity contract.

**The values no longer change** ("No new reading since …" in the widget, same
year total) while the state is "Connected": the integration reads the website
fine, but Gaz de Bordeaux has published no new day there. Open
[life.gazdebordeaux.fr](https://life.gazdebordeaux.fr) in a browser: if the
latest days are missing there too, the meter readings no longer reach Gaz de
Bordeaux (meter, transmission by Enedis or GRDF, data collection consent);
contact their customer service. Days that arrive late are picked up on their
own at the next refresh.

The integration logs (Gladys → Integrations → Gaz de Bordeaux → logs) give the
details. They never contain the password nor the session token.

This integration is not published by Gaz de Bordeaux: it reads the same data
as your customer account. If the website changes, it may stop working until
an update.

## Configuration settings

These are the settings Gaz de Bordeaux asks for in its configuration screen in Gladys.

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Getting started | `section` | No | Enter the email and password of your Gaz de Bordeaux customer account (the ones of the life.gazdebordeaux.fr website). The integration reads your consumption from it a few times a day: Gaz de Bordeaux publishes each day's reading one or two days later. One device is offered per contract (gas, electricity). |
| Email | `string` | Yes | The email you sign in to your Gaz de Bordeaux customer account with. |
| Password | `secret` | Yes |  |
| Refresh interval (hours) | `number` | No | How often the customer account is read. The readings change once a day: every 6 hours is plenty. |
| Days of history to import | `number` | No | Daily readings imported into Gladys when a device is created, so its charts do not start empty. |
| Gas alert threshold (kWh/day) | `number` | No | The "High daily consumption" scene trigger fires when a day of gas goes above it. 0 turns it off. |
| Electricity alert threshold (kWh/day) | `number` | No | The "High daily consumption" scene trigger fires when a day of electricity goes above it. 0 turns it off. |

## How to install Gaz de Bordeaux in Gladys

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**: Gaz de Bordeaux appears in the catalog, next to the native integrations, with a community badge.
2. Click **Install**. Gladys pulls the Docker image (`ghcr.io/prohand/gladys-gazdebordeaux:1.1.1`), starts it in a sandbox isolated from the core, and generates the integration's interface (devices, discovery and configuration).
3. Open the **Configuration** screen of the integration, fill in the settings, and save.
4. You can also install it directly from its repository URL: [https://github.com/prohand/gladys-gazdebordeaux](https://github.com/prohand/gladys-gazdebordeaux).

Gaz de Bordeaux requires Gladys `>=5.3.0`. The catalog inside Gladys refreshes every hour, so a new version becomes available at most one hour after its release.

Not running Gladys yet? It is free and open source: [follow the installation guide](/docs/) to get started.

## About external integrations

Gaz de Bordeaux is an **external integration**: a community integration packaged as a Docker container and published on GitHub, that Gladys installs in one click and runs in a sandbox isolated from its core. It is published and maintained by [prohand](https://github.com/prohand), not by the Gladys core team.
